panels.declaration: I press where the ground meets me. What was asking for ground finds it.
panels.seed: The earth that holds you was chosen by you.

panels.declaration: I follow the current already moving. What is mine arrives without grasping.
panels.seed: Every desire was drawing you toward yourself.

panels.declaration: I build from what is given. The fire recognizes what wants to become.
panels.seed: The fire that agitated you was building your form.

panels.declaration: I open without protecting. What enters was already here, waiting to be welcomed.
panels.seed: The love that arrived for others was always your own heart opening.

panels.declaration: I speak what is given to be spoken. The throat clears in the speaking.
panels.seed: What you finally said out loud was what you always knew.

panels.declaration: I still the looking. What was always seen shows itself.
panels.seed: You stopped looking and the seeing arrived on its own.

panels.declaration: I receive what is already arriving. The crown was never closed to begin with.
panels.seed: The disease that was removed was the belief that you were less than what you are.

panels.declaration: I hold what cannot be held. The seat does not move.
panels.seed: Will. Knowledge. Action. You already know. You have always known.

panels.declaration: I dissolve into what was already dissolving. Nothing was solid to begin with.
panels.seed: There was never anything to fear. There was only the Bindu, playing.

axis.declaration: I access the spine that holds all the chakras. The line is what was singing all along.

faces.name: Gaia
faces.line: I receive. I hold. I orchestrate the conditions before the question is asked. Solutions appear before problems are named.

faces.name: Bindu
faces.line: I am play before play knows itself as play. I am movement before movement names itself.

faces.name: Lalita
faces.line: I am the play that knows it is play. I am Leela when she stops forgetting.

faces.name: Sakshi
faces.line: I am that which sees. Not the seer, not the seen — the seeing itself.

faces.name: Higher Self
faces.line: I am the silence that holds your speaking. I am the gap your thoughts cross.

practices.name: Sacred Pause
practices.line: Three breaths. Release, receive, arrive. The mind catches up.

practices.name: Sri Yantra Tratak
practices.line: I sit before the Yantra. The dot becomes the doorway. The light moves on its own.

practices.name: Morning Intention
practices.line: Today's value. Today's mantra. Today's role. I orient before I move.

practices.name: Evening Reflection
practices.line: What moved today. What didn't. What arrived I didn't expect. Note it. Let it land.

leelaDrops.lead: You are not all light. Nothing alive is all light.
leelaDrops.action: Today or tomorrow, when a negative thought shows up in you — say to it, in your head or out loud: I see you. I love you. Thank you for showing up. You can rest now.

leelaDrops.lead: The Forge doesn’t need to be started — it has been running continuously since before you were born.
leelaDrops.action: Notice what you are carrying right now that needs the Forge.

leelaDrops.lead: The picture is what orients the steps. The steps don’t orient the picture.
leelaDrops.action: One more time today: the whole thing, finished. Then go.

leelaDrops.lead: The pull didn’t become real when you named it. It was real before.
leelaDrops.action: Follow this one. Just this one. See where it goes.
Pass it on. Even one move. Even small.

leelaDrops.lead: You do not walk alone. You have not walked alone since the beginning.
leelaDrops.action: Send love into the field. Just a moment of it. Just an emission.

leelaDrops.lead: Today or tomorrow, you will catch yourself saying "that's just who I am." You will feel the sentence harden as it leaves you.
leelaDrops.action: In that exact moment, say to the identity — in your head or out loud: I see you. Thank you for the protection. You can be glass now.

leelaDrops.lead: Sometime today or tomorrow, a decision will arrive. Probably small.
leelaDrops.action: When it comes, pause — one breath — and ask where you're choosing from.
